title: zellCrashHost (zell-crash-1): the Zell crash story event + the two catch-duels
description: Byte-identical in HolobotsMobile Schemas/ and HolobotsUnity Schemas/. DECISIONS #72.74 / #72.75; beat sheet HolobotsUnity Documentation/HANDOFFS/2026-10-23-zell-crash-beat-sheet.md. Host-owned (hard rule 1): the host records the crash once (zellCrash.seen, trophy stolen), flips storyFlags.holoZonesArcBuilt, meets Zell, issues each catch-duel (duel-rules-4 input-log block + the catch-escape-1 condition) and settles it from its own replay, always `escaped`. Nothing is granted, charged or healed. Unity presents only. Default off (host env HOLOCITY_ZELL_CRASH=1); off = every operation refuses `unavailable`.

duelInputs.description: Capability: the client records + uploads duel-inputs-2.

inputLog.description: The duel-inputs-2 log (object or compact wire string), ending on the first tick the issued escape condition holds, or on the core's own end.

catchEscape.description: Checked after every tick on the core state, side 1 = the runner (Zell's JUSAN). The duel stops on the first tick ANY enabled threshold holds; 0 disables a threshold. Order of the reported cause: caught, ring_stop, runner_hp, time. Never part of the rules hash or state hash.

ringStops.description: FightChaseSide.RingStops of side 1 >= this; the core counts TICKS the ring stopped the runner (#72.65 (6)), so 30 = one second pinned.

runnerHpPm.description: Active side-1 fighter: Hp * 1000 <= runnerHpPm * MaxHp (fight HP).

seen.description: zellCrashSeen: the host recorded the crash event.

trophy.description: null until the crash; `recovered` is reserved for the band-3 guardian lane (not set by zell-crash-1).

storyFlags.description: Unchanged four keys (Unity readers pin this set); zellCrashSeen travels in zellCrash.seen.

catchReceipt.description: duel-receipt-2's fields (Schemas/duel-receipt-2.json) as the HOST replay computed them, except: schemaVersion `zell-catch-receipt-1`; reason adds `escaped` (the escape condition stopped the duel before the core ended); plus outcome (always `escaped`) and cause.

zellPhase.description: zell-story-1 phase; the crash meets Zell (unmet -> rival).

roster.description: The arena-gathering-1 roster rows (same host function): the 8 citizen-pilots who fall in beat 3.

alreadySeen.description: crash only: true = the event was already recorded; nothing was written.

alreadyIssued.description: issueCatch: true = the open catch's same immutable block (no new seed).

duel.description: issueCatch: the rival-battle input-log issue block (FightReplayIssueWire) on duel-rules-4: rulesId `duel-rules-4:<catchId>`, the travel squad at full HP vs JUSAN, the runner-biased CPU profile.

alreadyProcessed.description: settleCatch: true = replay of the stored ruling; nothing was written.

x-refusals.unavailable: flag off, malformed stored state, or no account
x-refusals.arena_arc_required: crash before the third tournament win
x-refusals.crash_required: a catch before the crash event
x-refusals.unknown_catch: settle with a catchId the account was not issued
x-refusals.replay_mismatch: the log does not reproduce the issued duel, or does not end on the escape tick
